name: zed_1
note: ArenaDefense voxel zombie, built by build-assets.mjs from Zed_1.obj
(Shared/voxel/characters/Package/OBJ) at ArenaDefense/public/assets/models/zed_1.glb.
Height 1.8 m grounded at y=0, EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization,
single mesh, single material, no skeleton -- rig.mjs ingests it directly
(registers MeshoptDecoder and dequantizes on write), no separate uncompressed
source is needed.
IMPORTANT: the root node carries translation [0,0.9,0] and uniform scale 0.9
(the KHR_mesh_quantization dequantization node), and mergeGeometry reads
POSITION straight off the primitive without applying it. So every coordinate
below is mesh-local = (world - [0,0.9,0]) / 0.9, not the 1.8 m world height
you would read off a screenshot. World-space joint heights were measured by
slicing the point cloud into 0.02-0.05 m horizontal slabs (see
glb-rigger/verify/_slice_probe.mjs, _hist_probe.mjs, _armcentroid_probe.mjs,
_yrange_probe.mjs) and converted with that formula.
Pose: arms hang straight at the sides (not a T-pose), legs separate with a
real gap. The leg gap in the point cloud closes between world y=0.55 and
y=0.60 -- crotch measured at y=0.59, i.e. 32.8% of height, matching the
~34% estimate from the OBJ source. Shoulder (where the wide arm+torso
silhouette narrows) sits at y=1.40 (77.8%). Each arm hangs essentially
straight down at x=+/-0.18..0.21, z=-0.04, from shoulder y=1.40 to hand
y=0.62 (elbow split at the midpoint, y=1.01 -- the arm shows no visible
bend in the point cloud, so the elbow split is a straight-line guess).
Character faces +Z; right hand is on -X (matches the shared convention).
No overrides: at 15x64x9 voxels there is no prop or geometry that reads
nearer the wrong bone by distance alone.

joints.comment: Runs from the crotch (world y=0.60) to the shoulder line (world y=1.40). Greedy so the torso stays whole against the legs and arms.
joints.name: torso
